descriptions.w3d_hud_manager_construct_80119e10: Constructs the HUD manager and publishes its singleton pointer.
descriptions.w3d_hud_manager_destroy_80119e50: Clears the HUD manager singleton and destroys its actor base.
descriptions.w3d_hud_derived_destroy_8011a108: Installs the derived HUD vtable and invokes the text destructor.
descriptions.w3d_hud_reset_transform_8011a304: Resets the text offset and sets the font scale vector to the observed default.
